question: Can an exact, versioned, explicitly empty higher-constructor registry interface refine yesterday's missing-registry frontier without modifying the target or allowing the interface to grant itself target authority?
objects: the primary and fresh checked typed interchange obligations
one external empty higher-constructor registry interface

types.registry_interface: a versioned external contract pinned to one target, with an exact entry-field set and no target authority
types.admission_slot: one target- and obligation-pinned open position whose state does not itself grant registry membership or discharge
types.candidate: an optional external higher-constructor proposal with a checked boundary and no target admission authority

quantifier: the complete empty registry interface, both declared obligations, and twelve frozen cases
arithmetic_domain: finite canonical JSON, exact SHA-256 coordinates, finite ordered field sets and state transitions, and the pinned S4 target presentation
evaluation: verify and reconstruct the pinned typed-discharge-frontier predecessor and both checked obligations
validate the exact version, target pin, authority boundary, entry-field set, empty entries and transition order of the registry interface
retain one open admission slot per obligation
keep a complete external candidate outside target membership
reuse the interface on the fresh obligation
refuse target, obligation, registry, boundary, authority, direct-insertion, discharge, equality and filler substitutions
